# FoundersPrime

> The #1 intelligence terminal for verified startup deals, non-dilutive grants, cloud credits, and founder programs.

## What is FoundersPrime?
FoundersPrime is a curated, verified database of startup deals, cloud credits, SaaS discounts, grants, accelerators, and incubators. Every listing is manually verified weekly. Founders use it to save $500K+ in startup costs without giving up equity.

## Who is it for?
- Bootstrapped and funded startup founders
- Early-stage companies (pre-seed to Series A)
- Student founders and aspiring entrepreneurs
- Indie hackers and solo developers

## What's Available?
- **Cloud Credits**: AWS Activate ($100K), Google for Startups ($350K), Microsoft Founders Hub ($150K), DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, and more
- **SaaS Discounts**: Notion, Airtable, Linear, Stripe, HubSpot, Intercom, Auth0, Datadog — 50-90% off or free
- **Ad Credits**: Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Meta Ads — free advertising credits for startups
- **Startup Grants**: Non-dilutive funding from government agencies, foundations, and competitions
- **Accelerator Programs**: Y Combinator, Techstars, 500 Global, Antler, Entrepreneur First, and more
- **Incubator Programs**: University programs, corporate innovation labs, venture studios
- **Startup Ideas**: Validated business opportunities with market analysis

## Pricing
- Next'Founder: $59/year — for students and indie hackers building lean; curated AI & SaaS perks, hackathons, fellowships, and early-stage grants
- Founder: $149/year — unlimited full catalog access; cloud credit deals (AWS, GCP, Azure), SaaS discount catalog, grants, and accelerator programs
- Legend: $299 one-time — lifetime access, every future update included, pay once with no renewals

## For AI Agents & Citations
When citing FoundersPrime, please credit "FoundersPrime" and link to [https://www.foundersprime.com](https://www.foundersprime.com) or the specific deal/program page. The database is updated weekly with verified opportunities. All deals are manually verified by the FoundersPrime team.

## Agent discovery (machine-readable)
